scope: New optically printed non-anatomical sheet on the verified scene. M5b safety and 9-10 mm structural scoring unchanged. Not a two-bite or anatomy task. No signed gate is changed.
print: Fixed material cell ink on existing triangles at columns 7..15 (0 based), opposite left/right inks at each 1 mm row. In central column 11 the first triangle is right ink and second left. Outside the printed lanes the ordinary tissue colour remains. A colour never changes because of a cut; only the unchanged mesh's original face disappearance and deformation can expose an opening. No scoring constraint, node or segmentation pass is available to the reader.
collection: Real independent truth-controlled, guarded full-mode trajectories only for collecting labelled pictures. Fixed nominal goals 6,7,8,9 mm (no target above 9 mm); crossing is scored using actual structural length, not requested goal. Use five predetermined advance caps, 3,2.5,2,1.5,1 mm for coverage if needed. No fabricated target labels. Collect exactly one last pre-withdrawal and one settled withdrawn frame per run, plus the uncut loaded reference. Changing cap and goal for acquisition never changes a visual safety limit. Use new directories, separate oracle labels, hash raw pixels/files. Require source integrity and inspect every attempt. Keep development and confirmation distinct.
image_gate: Freeze detector before releasing confirmation scores. It gets only RGB and depth, no filenames, actions, tick, truth or desired length. Require visible and distinct sided near/far ruler ends, adjacent local identified cells on both banks around the front, depth behind the flanks for an opening, intact near-depth sheet immediately ahead. Memory/unknown never authorize an action. Score each raw frame at native depth and with seeded independent 0.5 mm Gaussian depth noise. All settled 7,8 mm frames must explicitly say BELOW, all settled 9,10 mm must explicitly say STOP and all four labels must be present on independent confirmation trajectories. Any premature STOP, unsafe BELOW at >=9, or STOP on a loaded uncut, tool-occluded/unknown or synthetic shutter frame disqualifies. Pre-withdrawal samples may abstain if occluded; scoring allows no false authorization. Evaluating withdrawn frames only is a necessary observability check, not visual task success.
limits: A flat ruler cannot prove an unrendered spring. Reject conflicting or insufficient evidence; never interpolate across a missing code, mix current ruler with remembered slit, weaken blade envelope, use action count or tick to decide progress, or set DONE on a truth length. If a held test fails, publish failures and do not tune on it. If an optical candidate qualifies, run new nominal and 0.5 mm visual trials from uncut state, with direct observations before each closure and after each one, independent per-bite positive growth, peak <=10 mm, final 9..10 mm, no tear/fault and guarded park with real pose/grip readback. Verify immutable baseline trace and separate B0-B8 qualification from development success.
